mustFix.whyItLands: Three independent grounds. (1) Not landed: MF1 expressly named the Alternatives bullet as a site of the two-readings defect and asked for one consistent reading of the predicate; this bullet still asserts the narrow reading ('Decision 2's triggers govern a recorded leftover-join, not a design-contract candidate') while item 4 now asserts the broad one. The front-matter sentence 'This turn lands every turn-1 identifier' is therefore false for CLAUDE-D363-MF1. (2) Misreads D-364: clause 1 holds that the predicate reaches preview-product-boundary-successor.v10 and clause 2 that applying Decision 1 while denying Decision 2 'is not available'. The bullet does exactly that, in an entry that will be adopted as governing COORD text one heading after D-364. (3) Internal contradiction on the successor question: item 4 and the front matter say a successor is owed and not discharged; the bullet says 'D-314 item 1 requires no further successor' as a ground for rejecting it. Both cannot stand in one adopted entry, and the bullet is the only place the entry explains why v11 is not required first, so a reader routing off Alternatives gets the foreclosed answer instead of the D-364 clause 3 / clause 6 answer.
mustFix.notDisputed: The alternative is correctly rejected; the ground is wrong. Under D-364 clauses 3 and 6 the v11 successor is owed but is not a gate-2 remainder, so gates 4 and 5 may proceed with it named. That is what item 4 already says.
mustFix.remedy: Rewrite the bullet's rejection ground to D-364, e.g.: 'Rejected: under D-364 clause 3 that successor is not an acceptance-evidence member and is not a D-056 gate-2 remainder; under clause 6 this cycle proceeds with it named as outstanding (item 4) and measures the row's remainder against live bytes (item 3); under clause 7 it does not move gate 1. D-294 Decision 1 still reads the four frozen sentences as custody at D-295 (D-364 clause 2). The successor remains owed.' Delete 'D-294 Decision 2's triggers govern a recorded leftover-join, not a design-contract candidate' and 'D-314 item 1 requires no further successor'. Optionally add to the 'Why this entry exists' quotation of D-314 item 1 (lines 79-83) that the 'no further successor' clause modifies the opening performed at D-316, as D-364 clause 2 and this entry's item 4 now read it.

advisories.text: 'Under D-364 clause 3 that successor is a Decision 3 citation refresh' — clause 3's own words are 'A Decision 2(b) citation-refresh successor'. D-294 Decision 3 is the refresh rule the successor would perform and D-364 clause 1 uses 'under D-294 Decision 3' for preview-product-boundary-successor.v10's own refresh, so the sense is right, but the attribution to clause 3 is not verbatim. Align to 'a Decision 2 (b) citation-refresh successor (which performs a D-294 Decision 3 refresh)'. Not blocking.

'OBL-2 on distribution-core leftover-join.v10 (D-308), which is UNDECIDED-number design plus execution, not fixture authoring.' Measured: distribution-core-leftover-join.v10 OBL-2 leftoverDesign true, existingGate DR-G01..DR-G05, reason 'Remainder is (a) G02 tree-accounting UNDECIDED, so G02 size comparison cannot be scored, and (b) G01-G05 execution ... D-293 decided MB means 1e6 bytes for the D-006 G01/G02/G04 quantities', summary.d006UnitUndecided false. The operative claim (design plus execution, not fixture authoring) holds and 'still-UNDECIDED numbers' is D-056 gate 2's own category, but the D-006 unit is no longer UNDECIDED; the precise remainder is G02 tree-accounting. Consider 'G02 tree-accounting UNDECIDED plus G01–G05 execution'. Not blocking.
